profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Generative AI • LLM/RAG Agents • Java/Spring Boot • Microservices • AWS/Kubernetes
profile.summary:
I build backend systems that don’t fail when it matters.

Over the past 10+ years, I’ve worked across insurance, ERP, and aviation, designing and scaling distributed systems that handle millions of users, financial-critical data, and real-time operations where downtime has real consequences.

My focus is at the intersection of scale, reliability, and system design, especially in environments where performance and correctness are equally critical.

Recently, I’ve been building AI-powered systems in production, including troubleshooting and diagnostics agents leveraging LLMs, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). These systems analyze logs, retrieve relevant context, and automate root cause detection—reducing claims/incidents by ~30% and improving system reliability.

Some highlights:
• Built AI-driven diagnostics agents using LLMs + RAG, reducing incidents by ~30%
• Decomposed a monolithic claims platform into microservices, improving API response times by ~35%
• Led an Oracle EBS to Fusion Cloud migration, reducing month-end close from 5 days to 2
• Built automated testing frameworks that reduced production regressions by ~40%

I’ve also led teams of up to 6 engineers and enjoy mentoring, two engineers I worked closely with were promoted within 18 months.

I’m particularly interested in roles at the intersection of backend systems and AI, where intelligent workflows and scalable infrastructure come together to solve real-world problems.


Tech stack:
Java · Spring Boot · AWS · Kubernetes · Kafka · PostgreSQL · Python

Best way to reach me: fernandochavezestrada@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building scalable backend systems and AI-powered diagnostics solutions for high-volume insurance platforms.

- Designed and implemented AI-powered troubleshooting and diagnostics agents using LLMs, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), reducing claims/incidents by ~30%

- Built semantic search and context retrieval pipelines using vector embeddings to enable accurate, context-aware diagnostics across distributed systems

- Developed agent-based workflows using an AI agent framework (ADK) to orchestrate multi-step reasoning for log analysis, root cause detection, and remediation recommendations

- Architected and scaled backend services on AWS handling high-throughput workloads for millions of users, improving system reliability and reducing latency by ~30%

- Led decomposition of a monolithic claims platform into microservices, enabling independent service scaling, faster deployments, and improved system resilience

- Built event-driven architectures using Kafka to support real-time data processing and decoupled communication across critical business domains

- Designed and deployed containerized services using Kubernetes, improving scalability, fault tolerance, and deployment consistency across environments

- Implemented automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines, reducing production regressions by ~40% and accelerating release cycles

- Led technical design and system architecture decisions, balancing scalability, consistency, and performance in business-critical applications

- Mentored engineers and contributed to team growth, helping improve code quality, system design practices, and overall delivery velocity
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache Kafka · Kubernetes · Microservices · Distributed Systems · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · AI Systems · LLMs · Systems Design · Python · Software Development · Problem Solving · Debugging · Scrum

positions.title: Senior Applications Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed, deployed, and maintained Oracle EBS ERP applications, with specialization in the General Ledger module, improving system functionality, accuracy, and efficiency for finance operations.

- Translated complex business requirements into customized technical solutions, writing high-quality, efficient Java code following industry best practices.

- Diagnosed and resolved performance bottlenecks, reducing query response times and ensuring high availability for critical financial systems.

- Conducted rigorous testing (JUnit, integration, and regression) to ensure system reliability and compliance with enterprise standards.

Key Accomplishments

- Modernized legacy ERP systems by implementing Spring Boot microservices and developing SOAP/RESTful web services, improving modularity and maintainability.

- Increased scalability and resiliency by deploying microservices on AWS EC2 with Docker containers and AWS Lambda, cutting downtime and boosting performance.

- Migrated financial data from Oracle EBS to Oracle Fusion Cloud, streamlining reporting with Fusion Accounting Hub Reporting Cloud Services and reducing reporting delays by 35%.

- Developed the Bug Closure Template Application, automating defect resolution tracking and reducing resolution time by 25%.

- Enabled smooth collaboration by managing version control with Git and driving Agile practices, improving team delivery speed.

- Enhanced user experience by developing responsive front-end pages using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Developed, maintained, and optimized the DANA application using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate, ensuring system stability and long-term maintainability.

- Architected microservices and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Spring Security, improving modularity, scalability, and security of core applications.

- Integrated Swagger into Spring Boot services for dynamic API documentation, reducing onboarding and debugging time for developers.

- Enhanced testing workflows for aircraft engine systems, integrating a real-time simulator that improved reliability analysis under diverse operating conditions.

- Streamlined testing efficiency by automating key processes, cutting manual verification time and improving robustness.

- Built responsive UIs with AngularJS, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, enabling seamless user interaction with backend services.

Key Accomplishments

- Improved system scalability and security by introducing a microservices-based architecture with robust authentication and authorization layers.

- Boosted testing performance and reduced defect detection time by 20% through simulation integration and workflow automation.

- Delivered high-quality, reliable code by applying Core Java best practices (collections, concurrency, exception handling).

- Played a key role in cross-functional collaboration, ensuring smooth integration between backend systems and user-facing applications.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and built the Issues Application, a critical tool that streamlined the aircraft engine part repair process, reducing turnaround time and improving supplier collaboration.

- Developed robust backend services with Java and Spring Boot, enabling seamless data flow between front-end interfaces and underlying databases.

- Authored complex SQL queries (joins, indexes, nested queries) to optimize retrieval of critical repair data and improve system performance.

- Delivered end-to-end technical support, including server administration, database management, and website deployment, ensuring reliability and uptime of business-critical applications.

Key Accomplishments

- Improved supplier communication and process transparency by integrating supplier interaction features directly into the Issues Application.

- Led the design and deployment of a modern Graphical User Interface (GUI) for the company intranet, enhancing usability and accessibility of repair and reporting data.

- Strengthened system performance through database optimization and server-side improvements, ensuring robust handling of growing data volumes.

projects.title: SIE (Sistema Integral de ECIM).
projects.description:
The SIE system enables the business model to be completely digitized, so that time spent in capturing applications, manage groups of perseverance, management meetings and events was reduced by 60%. It removes: duplication of roles, paperwork, loss of information and increases data integrity.
Specification of software requirements, software analysis, software design: specifically in the design of the system architecture and persistence model. Development of test plan for the system.
Software Development: Development of modules that manage the main flow of an application through the business model of the ECIM organization.
